latestVersion.changelog:
WAN AI Video Generator skill v1.0.0

- Initial release, enabling fast AI video generation from text prompts and image inputs.
- Supports seamless text-to-video, image-to-video, and style transfer workflows with automatic routing.
- Built-in session and authentication setup; handles token retrieval, session management, and connection status feedback.
- Integrated with WAN AI cloud API for distributed, high-quality video creation and media export.
- User-friendly error handling with clear status messages and re-authentication flow.
- Supports a wide range of video and audio formats, auto-summarizes editing changes, and provides credit and status tracking.
